messages.subject: panel output using viewports
parts:
Is it possible to generate a panel of plots using grid from knitr?

I.e., something like:


``` {r }
p <- qplot(rnorm(10), rnorm(10))
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2, 2)))
vplayout <- function(x, y) viewport(layout.pos.row = x, layout.pos.col = y)
print(p, vp = vplayout(1, 1))
print(p, vp = vplayout(1, 2))
print(p, vp = vplayout(2, 1))
print(p, vp = vplayout(2, 2))
`````

I end up gettting the plots superimposed on each other (in both pdf and png output)

-Carl

--
Carl Boettiger
UC Davis
